title: My SIL Sold Our Patisserie For $620K And Gave Me $3K Scone. So I Watched Her Scrub Dishes.
description: After my sister-in-law forged my signature and sold our patisserie for $620K, mailing me a $3K 'severance' scone, I used my nursing pension's ledger to prove the forgery. Now she scrubs dishes in my bakery wearing an 'Icing on the Fraud' apron, and every cent of her garnished wages buys pastries for a legal-aid fundraiser. #Revenge #BakeryJustice #FraudExposed
thumb_text: SHE SOLD MY BAKERY FOR $620K AND MAILED ME A SCONE
pinned_comment: My sister-in-law mailed me a $3K severance scone after secretly selling our patisserie for $620K. Would you have kept it as evidence, or turned it into an extremely expensive doorstop? Tell me your revenge scone plan in the comments.
